prompt:
SUMMARY: hairstyle a chin-length blunt bob with a side part and one neatly tucked side; costume silhouette complete full-body armor with plates joined seamlessly from neck to feet — bare skin only on the face and where EXPOSURE allows, dense visible seams and joints; design idea The armored waist and lower plates form nested gate-shaped blast shields with visible mechanical locking seams.; face diamond-shaped face with softly defined cheekbones and a tapered chin, hooded eyes, brows with a clean, angled peak; expression calm resolve.

A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Luo Xian of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the steadfast general who held Yong'an even after Shu fell.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a young-adult face.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: a mature, poised woman; light honey-beige skin; diamond-shaped face with softly defined cheekbones and a tapered chin; hooded eyes; hazel eyes; brows with a clean, angled peak; a nose with a gentle aquiline curve; lips with a defined cupid's bow, of natural size.
Body and hair: toned athletic-curvy, full-busted with rounded hips build; a chin-length blunt bob with a side part and one neatly tucked side; ocean-blue hair.
Expression: a firm, resolute look with calm, steady eyes, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: unbroken resolve on the walls against both Wu and Wei, heavy armor.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MECHA
Costume: a female mecha personification built as an assault-type mecha frame — heavy armor plates, thruster packs, reinforced limbs, her weapon rebuilt as a large mecha armament. Solid hard-surface plates with visible joints cover her frame except at the openings named under Exposure; any cape or skirt is made of rigid armored plates; her face and hair stay human.
Silhouette: complete full-body armor with plates joined seamlessly from neck to feet — bare skin only on the face and where EXPOSURE allows, dense visible seams and joints. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Design idea: The armored waist and lower plates form nested gate-shaped blast shields with visible mechanical locking seams.
Colours: jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade, with small accents of deep plum purple and black lacquer (the Sima Jin). Faction frame: jade-green and white plating with imperial-gold trims, organic layered armor like overlapping leaves, a resilient all-terrain frame, warm green glow lines.
Signature item: a heavy tower shield, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare upper arms below the pauldrons, which stay seated on top of her shoulders, and a bare waist and midriff between the bust plate and the hip armor; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2190, the Shu frontier colony on a jade-green moon: terraced garden cities under vast glass domes, a ringed gas giant filling the sky, an orbital elevator climbing into space, starship docks glowing green.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — emblems are abstract insignia shapes only, never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A far-future setting only — space stations, starships and high-tech structures — with no traditional East-Asian architecture.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.

observations: One adult woman, complete full body and feet within frame.
Additional polearm appears beyond the specified tower shield.
Hairstyle and silhouette fidelity vary; original output preserved without regeneration.

acceptance: user selected 4,1,4; ordinary push to main authorized
